title: Ensuring Staffing Adequacy with Additional 40,000 Infant Care and Childcare Places Coming Onstream
what_it_is: Ensuring Staffing Adequacy with Additional 40,000 Infant Care and Childcare Places Coming Onstream

sections.label: Early childhood educator workforce growth
sections.summary: The early childhood educator workforce grew from over 18,000 in 2018 to over 25,000 today, with another 1,500 educators estimated to be needed.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Our early childhood educator workforce grew from over 18,000 in 2018 to over 25,000 today.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Notwithstanding these efforts, we estimate that another 1,500 more educators will be needed in the coming years.

sections.label: Educator salaries and well-being measures
sections.summary: Salaries of early childhood educators in Government-supported preschools were raised, and Teachers' Day and Children's Day became preschool holidays from 2024.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: We raised salaries of early childhood educators in Government-supported preschools to keep pace with market wages and professional skills.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: We also improved the well-being of early childhood educators by designating Teachers' Day and Children's Day as preschool holidays from 2024 and removing the requirement for childcare centres to operate on Saturdays from 2025.

sections.label: MSF manpower discussions with ministries
sections.summary: MSF holds regular discussions with the Ministry of Manpower and the Ministry of Trade and Industry to look at the economy's manpower needs.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: There are many industries out there who are looking for skilled talents to fill places.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: So, in relation to the question that she asked, apart from MSF who holds discussions with NCSS, there are also regular discussions between MSF and the Ministry of Manpower, and the Ministry of Trade and Industry, to take a holistic look at what are the manpower needs of the entire economy.

sections.label: ECDA 2022 salary review
sections.summary: In 2022, ECDA conducted a review of early childhood educators' salaries to ensure they are commensurate with contributions and professional skills.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: In 2022, ECDA had conducted a review of the salaries of early childhood educators to ensure that their salaries are commensurate with their contributions as well as professional skills.

sections.label: Reducing preschool fee caps
sections.summary: Over the past two years, fee caps have been steadily reduced, meaning parents pay less per year and per month for preschool expenses.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: In fact, over the past two years, we have been steadily reducing those fee caps, meaning that parents actually pay less per year, per month, for preschool expenses, which also translates to less out-of-pocket expenses for parents.

sections.label: ECDA relief staff service providers
sections.summary: In October 2024, ECDA appointed service providers to offer affordable and reliable relief staff services to all preschools.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: One thing that ECDA has done is that, in October 2024, ECDA had appointed service providers to offer affordable and reliable relief staff services to all preschools.

sections.label: Preschool manpower relief pool
sections.summary: Policy should work with industry to ensure a relief pool of manpower for preschools to plug short-term shortages at individual centres.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Fundamentally, I think what we should do, as a matter of policy is to work with the industry to ensure that there is a relief pool of manpower that the preschools are able to call upon to plug short-term manpower shortages at individual centres.
